//: The package's manifest, packed as bin/resource.json (semanticshare PkgResources). files and versions are written by tasks.py package(), from tasks.*.json; the rest is written here by hand.
// upgrade_from: the installed versions this package upgrades, both inclusive and optional
// upgrader: the oldest upgrade tool (synodepy3) that installs this package
// upgrades: Upgrades of the configuration files an upgrade keeps (semanticshare ConfigUpgrades). since: the minimum installed version an entry applies to; entries accumulate, the oldest first. replace: renamed values; add: what is missing, never changing what is there. {settings.x}: a value of the installed WEB-INF/settings.json.
